title: Better Bricks
description: This resource pack redefines the use of bricks in an interesting way.
body:
**_This resource pack changes the texture of bricks to make building easier_**. _The changes include_:

 **Chiseled Nether Bricks have a blaze instead of a wither skeleton and is more bright.**

**Bricks look more messy and look like they have copper nuggets inside. Perfect for a brick crafting recipe that uses copper nuggets.**

**Light breeze-like lines on Chiseled Tuff Bricks.**

**Makes the moss on Mossy Stone Bricks more colourful and noticeable.**

**A guardian eye is noticeable on Prismarine Bricks but it is intentionally slightly difficult to find due to most prismarine builds being disturbed if it was larger.**

**Adds corners to Chiseled Stone Bricks, This is because it's usually used in a corner of a stone brick build.**

**Makes Chiseled Resin Bricks take on a golden colour and the creaking icon on it has more shading.**

_**This resource pack is still in progress. Some bricks may have work-in-progress textures
(meaningless re-colours and nothing more). This is due to lack of time and will be fixed in a later update.**_
